changes.name: EnergySounds
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local energy=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Energy")
local last=energy.Value

local pickup=Instance.new("Sound")
pickup.Name="EnergyPickupSound"
pickup.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
pickup.Volume=.7
pickup.PlaybackSpeed=1.35
pickup.Parent=SoundService

energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
 local now=energy.Value
 if now>last then
  pickup.PlaybackSpeed=1.25+math.random()*0.2
  pickup:Play()
 end
 last=now
end)

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local core=world:WaitForChild("EnergyCore")
local old=core:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.Name="GrowPrompt";prompt.ObjectText="Energy Core";prompt.ActionText="Grow Island";prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.25;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=14;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=core

local event=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandFeedback")
if not event then event=Instance.new("RemoteEvent");event.Name="GrowIslandFeedback";event.Parent=ReplicatedStorage end
local costs={10,30,70,140}
local names={"Expansion1","Expansion2","Bridge","TreasureIsland"}
local function showStage(n) local p=world:FindFirstChild(names[n]);if p then p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true end end
local busy={}
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 if busy[player] then return end;busy[player]=true
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy");local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if energy and stage then
  if stage.Value>=#costs then prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" else
   local cost=costs[stage.Value+1]
   if energy.Value>=cost then
    energy.Value-=cost;stage.Value+=1;showStage(stage.Value)
   else
    event:FireClient(player,"NotEnough",cost-energy.Value)
   end
   if stage.Value<#costs then prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - "..costs[stage.Value+1].." Energy" else prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!" end
  end
 end
 task.wait(.3);busy[player]=nil
end)

changes.name: CoreFeedback
changes.source:
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local event=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GrowIslandFeedback")
local fail=Instance.new("Sound")
fail.Name="NotEnoughEnergySound"
fail.SoundId="rbxasset://sounds/uuhhh.mp3"
fail.Volume=.65
fail.PlaybackSpeed=1.1
fail.Parent=SoundService
event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind)
 if kind=="NotEnough" then fail:Play() end
end)
